---
title: "After the day"
---
The tools part of the day can only open each layer, and the [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) is where each one is taken further.

| If you want | Read |
|---|---|
| The document format in full: the header, chunk options, figures, tables, cross-references and citations | [Quarto and reproducible documents](../../companion/quarto.qmd) |
| Version control from first principles, and a repository of your own online | [Git and GitHub](../../companion/git-github.qmd) |
| Where finished work is deposited, what a licence lets travel, the Open Science Framework after 2026, and the preregistration templates | [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd) |
| Where the data come from: the archives, survey programmes and statistical offices, and the course's own sources step by step | [Social science data sources](../../companion/data-sources.qmd) |
| To turn your own GESIS downloads into the respondent file, the scales and the panel | [Building the analysis file](../../companion/data-management.qmd) |
| The IDE in depth, and the differences between the three | [Positron, RStudio and VS Code](../../companion/ide.qmd) |
| The rest of R, from the first line to a grammar of graphics | [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd) |
| The statistics behind what you fitted, output by output | [The statistical methods behind the course](../../companion/stats-methods.qmd) |
| The ideas behind the multiverse, and the arguments against it | [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) |

The [replication-focused day](../one-day-replication/index.qmd) is the original balance of this course, the [methods-focused day](../one-day-methods/index.qmd) gives the statistics the time this day gives the tools, and the [three-day format](../three-days/index.qmd) does both, with a tools day before the workshop and a methods day after it.
